$comment: Jarvis OS baseline Claude Code settings, injected into every managed project. Project-specific needs belong in the catalog's settings_overrides, not here and not in the project. `outputStyle` reaches user sessions and workers alike because both settings files build from this one — docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-22-agent-concision.md SS3.

PreToolUse.$comment: The two Serena names are both listed because a plugin install produces the long prefix and `claude mcp add serena` the short one; Jarvis configures no MCP server, so it cannot know which, and a matcher naming a tool that does not exist is inert. Named exactly and never `mcp__.*`: the hook is a ~155ms process per matched call and Serena's symbol tools are called constantly. Issue #845, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-a-runaway-tool-call-is-not-a-slow-subagent.md SS4. `Agent` and `Task` are named for the opposite arithmetic and it holds: the fleet made 272 foreground delegations in the measured period, so ~155ms x 272 = 42 seconds of hook process against $33.5 of cache writes — delegation is rare and expensive where a symbol lookup is frequent and cheap. Issue 868, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-a-lead-must-not-block-past-its-cache.md SS3b. `AskUserQuestion` is named because its dialog only an attached terminal can answer: the hook files it as Neo questions and denies it (wo-0d358979, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-a-worker-question-is-a-neo-question.md). `Artifact` is named so only an order the user asked for publishes, privately, and deletes only what the user chose to delete (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-artifact-session-hold.md §3.3). Read|Grep|Glob|WebFetch|WebSearch|SendMessage, every non-Serena `mcp__` tool and Serena's read and write tools by name are matched for the comment fence: a comment-woken turn of a held artifact session may run only ArtifactComments (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-artifact-session-hold.md §4.5.5). That puts the ~155ms hook on every Read and Serena symbol call fleet-wide, accepted there: `--disallowedTools` cannot ride a bare resume (F6).

PostToolUse.$comment: Three jobs: mirror Claude Code's own memory files into the OS knowledge base, hand the lead any message queued for it mid-turn (one stat() of .jarvis/inbox/<wo>.pending unless one waits), and re-assert the work-order record on the first tool call after a compaction. Unmatched (every tool) for the second one — a compacted worker's next call is usually Bash, and waiting for a file edit would leave it running blind until it made one. Costs one stat() per tool call until a PreCompact arms it.

PreCompact.$comment: Arms the re-assertion above. PreCompact cannot inject context and neither can PostCompact, so this only records and flags; PostToolUse delivers.

SubagentStart.$comment: The twin of SessionStart, which never fires for a subagent. A Task subagent inherits CLAUDE.md, skills, settings and hooks, and NOT the parent's --append-system-prompt, --agent persona or SessionStart additionalContext — so the house style and the project's standing worker instructions are re-injected here. No matcher: every agent type gets them, including the shipped jarvis-architect / jarvis-test-lead seats. Spec 2026-09-19-concision-enforced.md SS5.1.
